input.summary:
Surulere Chill Store, Beverages & Snacks shelf, audit confidence 0.86 (trustworthy). One of four planogram SKUs was out: Beloxxi Cream Crackers (0 of 3 expected facings, minimum 1). Gala Sausage Roll (3/3), McVitie's Digestive 250g (4/4) and Cabin Biscuit 200g (3/3) are all compliant. No unknown products; planogram share 100%.

Inventory check shows Beloxxi Cream Crackers has 11 units on hand against a reorder point of 6 — above the reorder point and more than the 9 units needed to restore 3 facings. So this is a shelf-refill problem, not a stock problem: no purchase order was raised. All other SKUs are also well above their reorder points (22, 15 and 11 units, reorder point 6), so no reorders at all.

Action for the store: pull 9 units of Beloxxi Cream Crackers from back-stock and refill the empty slot. A WhatsApp notification with these instructions was sent to the manager.

No telemetry was available for this store's fridge and the audit showed no visible damage, so no technician was dispatched. Only one SKU is out and confidence is high, so no escalation is needed.
